source.stem:
Which of the following options regarding Darwin’s theory of natural selection is incorrect ( )
A. All living things generally have strong reproductive capabilities
B. If living things want to survive, they must fight for survival in order to obtain food and space.
C. Variations produced by organisms must be conducive to adapting to the environment
D. Organisms that do not adapt to the environment will be eliminated

options.text: All living things generally have strong reproductive capabilities
If living things want to survive, they have to fight for food and space.
Variations produced by organisms must be conducive to adapting to the environment
Creatures that do not adapt to the environment will be eliminated

hinge.title: Decide whether a learner is describing adolescence as the human stage between childhood and adulthood, generally from about 10 to 19 years, when growth and reproductive maturity develop.
node_labels: Living systems: organisms, health and ecosystems

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Adulthood is the stage between childhood and full maturity, generally from about 10 to 19.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: Everyone begins adolescence on their tenth birthday and finishes on their nineteenth birthday.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: The body must already be reproductively mature before adolescence begins.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: A 12-year-old dog is in adolescence because adolescence occurs around ages 10 to 19.

intelligence.enrichment: Adolescence is the period of change from childhood to adulthood. It generally begins around 10 years of age and usually lasts until 19 years, and the body gradually reaches maturity for reproduction during this period. human growth over time -> adolescence -> physical, emotional, behavioural, and reproductive changes The learner identifies adolescence as the human period between childhood and adulthood, generally around ages 10 to 19, during which growth and reproductive maturity develop. Adolescence just means getting taller around middle school age.
